proposed_pathway.value: Photothermal oxidative dehydrogenation of propane to propylene over Cu/BN catalysts via localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) effect of Cu nanoparticles under visible light irradiation
proposed_pathway.source_quote: The localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) effect of Cu nanoparticles further enhanced the photothermal catalytic performances of Cu/BN catalysts under visible light irradiation.

value.name: B-O-N species
value.source_quote: The binding energies of B were located at 190.2 eV and 192.6 eV, which should be attributed to the B–N and B–O–N chemical bonds, respectively.

active_sites.value: Cu nanoparticles on BN supports with electron coupling between Cu-NPs and BN-NF
active_sites.source_quote: It indicated the electron coupling between Cu-NPs and BN-NF.

role_of_light.value: LSPR effect of Cu nanoparticles enhances light absorption and induces photothermal effect, boosting catalytic activity
role_of_light.source_quote: The plasmonic Cu-NPs could enhance the light-harvesting capacities, especially in the visible light region, which was a requirement for inducing photothermal effect.

value.finding: Successful loading of Cu onto BN supports confirmed by characteristic peaks at 43.3° and 50.2°
value.source_quote: Over the XRD patterns of Cu/BN catalysts, in addition to the diffraction peaks assigned to the hexagonal phase of BN, another two diffraction peaks at 43.3° and 50.2° appeared over Cu/BN-NS and Cu/BN-NF, which could be attributed to the (111) and (200) facets of metallic Cu, respectively.

value.finding: Cu nanoparticles with average sizes of 12.7, 9.7, and 7.4 nm on Cu/BN-NS, Cu/BN-NF, and Cu/BN-NP respectively
value.source_quote: The average sizes of Cu nanoparticles on the three catalysts were analyzed, and they were 12.7, 9.7, and 7.4 nm on Cu/BN-NS, Cu/BN-NF, and Cu/BN-NP, respectively.

value.finding: Electron coupling between Cu-NPs and BN-NF observed
value.source_quote: It indicated the electron coupling between Cu-NPs and BN-NF.

value.finding: Enhanced light absorption in visible region due to LSPR effect of Cu-NPs
value.source_quote: After the loading of Cu, the light absorption capacities of Cu/BN catalysts were extended to visible light and even near-infrared light regions.
